description: This file implements the ConsulBasedMembershipTable class, a C# class responsible for managing membership information within a distributed Orleans cluster using Consul as the backend. It includes methods for reading, inserting, updating, and deleting silo registration entries in Consul, as well as handling versioning and liveness updates. The class interacts with Consul's HTTP API through the IConsulClient interface and uses Orleans configurations.

classes.name: ConsulBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface for managing cluster membership data using Consul as the storage backend. Handles registration, updates, deletions, and retrieval of silo membership info, along with versioning and liveness signaling.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table; in this implementation, it's a no-op as Consul does not support extended TableVersion.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads membership data for a specific silo identified by its address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads the complete membership table data from Consul.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry for a silo.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing silo membership entry based on an etag for concurrency control.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the liveness heartbeat (IAmAlive) for a silo.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for the given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos that are no longer active and haven't sent liveness updates before a specified date.
